metadata.article_title: Notice to be in writing, signed.

article.title: Notice to be in writing, signed.
article.content: Every notice of transfer of an actionable claim shall be in writing, signed by the transferor or his agent duly authorised in this behalf, or, in case the transferor refuses to sign, by the transferee or his agent, and shall state the name and address of the transferee.
article.html:
131Notice to be in writing, signed.

Section 131 · Chapter VIII · page 45 of the Act

Every notice of transfer of an actionable claim shall be in writing, signed by the transferor or his agent duly authorised in this behalf, or, in case the transferor refuses to sign, by the transferee or his agent, and shall state the name and address of the transferee.
